policy.principle: One accountable owner and one declared write direction per entity; storage may remain federated.
policy.conflict_rule: Fail closed on duplicate external action; reconcile to the primary store through the declared bridge.
policy.automation_rule: No production automation may be added until ownership, validation, permissions, audit, idempotency, rollback, and kill-switch evidence are documented.

entities.scope: Discovered and qualified career opportunities across all job-search lanes.
entities.record_key: normalized source job ID, then canonical URL hash

authority.precedence: The main career pipeline owns the cross-lane record. JobZoom owns its scan execution rows and syncs qualified/applied outcomes to the main pipeline.

write_contract.direction: source collectors -> pipeline_db -> nasr-pipeline.db; JobZoom -> explicit sync bridge -> nasr-pipeline.db
forbidden: new flat-file job ledgers as an authority
direct external application from a discovery-only process
write_contract.dedupe: job_id/url_hash in main pipeline and linkedin_id/url/signature in JobZoom
write_contract.audit_evidence: status_history plus JobZoom runs and applied ledger
write_contract.rollback: restore the affected SQLite database from a verified SQLite backup before replay
write_contract.kill_switch: scripts/pipeline_db.py ENABLED flag; stop the producing lane

validation.evidence: pipeline schema, ATS gates, and quality-gate checks

permissions.evidence: HR local writes are pre-approved; external application rules remain gated

entities.scope: Application state, duplicate suppression, response, and interview progression.

authority.precedence: The main pipeline owns cross-lane application status. A positive applied marker in either store blocks duplicate action until reconciliation; JobZoom confirmations sync one way into the main pipeline.

write_contract.direction: confirmed application event -> owning ledger -> sync_applied_to_pipeline -> main pipeline
forbidden: application without duplicate precheck
clearing applied state because only one store is negative
write_contract.dedupe: positive-in-either-store fail-closed rule followed by bridge reconciliation
write_contract.audit_evidence: application status history, applied_jobs, and JSONL ledger
write_contract.rollback: reverse only a proven false marker with ledger evidence and owner approval
write_contract.kill_switch: stop application writer and preserve both ledgers for reconciliation

validation.evidence: known-answer, ATS, eligibility, and application gates

permissions.evidence: standard forms pre-approved; exceptions remain approval-gated

idempotency.evidence: positive-in-either-store suppression and unique ledger keys

kill_switch.evidence: stop writer; do not delete ledgers

entities.scope: Career recruiters and hiring relationships; this does not claim a general personal address book.
entities.record_key: normalized email, then LinkedIn URL, then reviewed name/company pair

authority.precedence: The recruiters table owns career-contact identity; messages and LinkedIn are evidence sources, not replacement contact ledgers.

write_contract.direction: verified interaction -> HR review -> pipeline_db recruiter record/link
forbidden: unverified identity merge
outreach status inferred from profile discovery alone
write_contract.dedupe: unique normalized email where present; otherwise reviewed identity match
write_contract.audit_evidence: interactions, job_recruiters, and dated contact notes
write_contract.rollback: unlink or correct a merge while retaining interaction evidence

permissions.evidence: local contact capture allowed; third-party messages remain gated

idempotency.evidence: unique email and reviewed fallback key

entities.scope: LinkedIn content approval, scheduling, publishing status, and canonical post record.

authority.precedence: Notion alone owns live approval, schedule, and publishing state. Local campaign files coordinate and learn but never override it.

write_contract.direction: approved CMO workflow -> direct Notion API -> publisher -> verified LinkedIn result -> Notion writeback
forbidden: local file promoted as approval authority
publish without exact content approval and duplicate lock
write_contract.dedupe: Notion page ID, published-state precheck, success ledger, and shared publish lock
write_contract.audit_evidence: Notion status history, publisher ledger, LinkedIn share ID, and campaign feedback
write_contract.rollback: stop publishing; repair Notion state from verified ledger evidence without deleting the public post unless Ahmed approves
write_contract.kill_switch: disable the owning publisher lane and retain Notion/ledger evidence

validation.evidence: draft, visual, duplicate, publisher-QA, and post-publish checks

audit_log.evidence: Notion, success ledger, and LinkedIn share ID

idempotency.evidence: single scheduler, shared lock, and success ledger

rollback.evidence: state repair and explicit public-delete gate

kill_switch.evidence: publisher lane can be disabled independently

live_evidence.needle: Notion remains the only live source of truth

entities.scope: Cross-workflow commitments and next actions; execution-run databases are logs, not intent authority.
entities.record_key: dated task heading plus stable workflow identity

authority.precedence: active-tasks.md owns the commitment. Taskflow/OpenClaw run databases prove execution only and cannot create or close a commitment by themselves.

write_contract.direction: Ahmed decision or verified workflow state -> NASR owner review -> active-tasks.md

entry_points.authority: NASR local-write within the approved workflow

forbidden: Mission Control task board
execution run treated as verified task closure
write_contract.dedupe: one stable task heading per workflow outcome
write_contract.audit_evidence: git diff, dated daily note, and cited operational evidence
write_contract.rollback: revert the scoped task edit while preserving the dated decision note
write_contract.kill_switch: stop automated task edits; task register remains manually reviewable

validation.evidence: task closure requires verified outcome evidence

permissions.evidence: workspace edit only; external action retains its own gate

entities.scope: Ahmed's calendar events and attendance state.
entities.record_key: provider calendar ID plus event ID

authority.precedence: The provider event is authoritative. The /tmp file is a read cache and never proves an event write or deletion.

write_contract.direction: approved calendar intent -> gog-calendar/connected provider -> returned event ID -> optional refreshed cache
forbidden: editing the /tmp cache as an event write
claiming success without returned provider event evidence
write_contract.dedupe: provider event ID and time/title duplicate precheck
write_contract.audit_evidence: provider response and subsequent provider read
write_contract.kill_switch: stop calendar connector writes; retain read-only access

validation.evidence: time zone, attendees, recurrence, and conflict check

permissions.evidence: calendar mutations require an explicit request

kill_switch.evidence: connector writes can be stopped independently

live_evidence.needle: cache them for the morning briefing

entities.scope: Gmail messages and threads; local sentinel state covers processing and alert delivery only.
entities.record_key: Gmail message ID and thread ID

authority.precedence: Gmail owns message content and state. Sentinel SQLite owns only ingestion checkpoints, dedupe, classifications, and alert-delivery state.

write_contract.direction: Gmail -> Pub/Sub/history/read -> sentinel state -> optional Ahmed alert; no mailbox write path
forbidden: send, draft, reply, forward, label, flag, trash, or delete from the sentinel
local classification treated as mailbox state
write_contract.dedupe: Gmail message ID, thread ID, and normalized material-event state hash
write_contract.audit_evidence: sentinel notifications, processed_messages, thread_states, and sanitized logs
write_contract.rollback: reprocess an uncheckpointed event; never mutate Gmail to repair local state
write_contract.kill_switch: stop the sentinel/reconciliation lane without changing Gmail

validation.evidence: complete-thread deterministic and model policy gates

audit_log.evidence: durable isolated state and sanitized logs

live_evidence.needle: No email write, draft, reply, forwarding, label, flag, trash, or delete path exists

entities.scope: Durable user decisions, workflow knowledge, lessons, and curated reference material.
entities.record_key: canonical Markdown path plus dated heading

authority.precedence: Curated Markdown owns durable knowledge. SQLite/FTS and conversation summaries are retrieval indexes or evidence sources and cannot silently overwrite canonical files.

write_contract.direction: verified fact/decision -> dated note -> reviewed promotion to one owning canonical file -> optional index rebuild

entry_points.authority: same-turn durable decision or correction capture

forbidden: raw session mining into active rules
index database treated as canonical content
duplicate fact copied into multiple owner files
write_contract.dedupe: one owning file per fact type; daily note before reviewed promotion
write_contract.audit_evidence: dated note, git diff, source citation, and optional compile/lint report
write_contract.rollback: revert the scoped Markdown promotion and rebuild read indexes
write_contract.kill_switch: disable ingest/index jobs while preserving canonical Markdown

permissions.evidence: local knowledge capture only; external ingest follows source access rules

idempotency.evidence: one owner file and reviewed promotion

kill_switch.evidence: indexes are disposable; canonical Markdown is preserved

entities.scope: OpenClaw configuration, cron, gateway, services, patches, and operational execution state.
entities.record_key: runtime object type plus native ID/name

authority.primary_system: OpenClaw live runtime and first-class stores
authority.precedence: Live first-class runtime state outranks reports and cold snapshots. Config changes follow schema validation and the gateway safety lane.

write_contract.direction: approved maintenance intent -> first-class CLI/config tool -> bounded lifecycle action -> live probe/readback -> report
forbidden: same-turn live gateway restart outside the maintenance lane
report or cold snapshot treated as live authority
silent model switch
write_contract.dedupe: native cron/job/service IDs, bounded locks, and external-action ledgers where applicable
write_contract.audit_evidence: config diff, cron run, service state, gateway probe, patch checks, and sanitized logs
write_contract.rollback: verified config/state backup plus detached bounded maintenance rollback
write_contract.kill_switch: disable the named cron/service/workflow; do not broadly stop OpenClaw

validation.evidence: schema, health, patch, plugin, cron, and Telegram checks

permissions.evidence: runtime changes remain approval-gated unless explicitly pre-approved

audit_log.evidence: config diff, run state, probes, and logs

idempotency.evidence: native IDs, deterministic handlers, and duplicate guards

kill_switch.evidence: narrow workflow/service disable, not global shutdown

workflows.end_evidence: qualified opportunity or verified application state recorded
